reviews.text: The staff was kind, welcoming, and attentive. They took great care of my pup Georgie and made the entire visit comfortable and easy. Highly recommend!

My cat has been a patient for about a year and I think they do a great job. He’s a senior cat with hyperthyroidism and kidney issues, so we’re here every couple of months for check ups and lab work. They really care for their patients, their communication and follow up is great, and they are very friendly. It’s obvious that they’re a really hard working team that does everything they can to help. Pricing seems reasonable and they do discuss estimates before doing any treatments. Special shout out to every team member who works at the front desk who always make me and Buddy feel welcome.
Always kind and accommodating.
Everyone here is very nice and I love how they treat my pet.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Great staff!

This clinic has always been super helpful to my cats and me. We went to their Wicker Park location when my soul cat had jaundice and passed last year. They were so compassionate and transparent with their pricing, even though they only saw him twice.

My Anastasia is now sick, and Dr. Garrison was so helpful, transparent with their pricing, and compassionate. I’d always go back to them.

We took our puppy for her wellness exam and vaccines to Companion Animal Hospital this past week and were provided with excellent care. The veterinarian and vet assistant were extremely knowledgable and respected our preferences with treatment. Our pup did not even wince receiving her vaccines, and was a very happy girl from beginning to end. This speaks to the comfort we all felt during the visit. We are glad to have a great animal hospital right in the neighborhood.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
I am very impressed with the professionalism of the entire team. They were very caring of my cat who was having some health issues!
Thank you for your rating! We appreciate your feedback and look forward to serving you again.
Our favorite vet!! Auggie is a nervous boy and in other vets he always found shots difficult. but they are so gentle and kind with him here, he doesn’t even need any calming medications!

Companion Animal Hospital River North has been incredible in caring for my 11-year-old senior golden retriever, Casper, through ongoing osteoarthritis, elbow calluses and what we initially feared could be a cancerous growth on his paw. For months, we’ve been coming in twice a week for bandage swaps, and the entire team has been consistently kind, patient and compassionate.

Dr. Bryant is extremely trustworthy and truly looks after your animals like they’re her own. Her team, especially Lavitchi and Skye, have become so trusted by us in caring for Casper. They know he doesn’t like going “in the back,” so they do his treatments with me in the room because that’s what makes him most comfortable. Just last week, after recommending a custom brace, Dr. Bryant took the time to measure out the dimensions of Casper's limbs so that it would be made perfectly (especially given the cost). That level of thoughtfulness means everything when you’re caring for a senior dog.

The front desk staff is also wonderful, especially Megan, who is always helpful and proactive about sharing coupons, savings options and ways to make care more manageable. When you’re spending thousands of dollars on senior dog care, that makes a huge difference.

We’re so grateful to have a team that not only provides great medical care, but also understands Casper’s personality, comfort and needs. Highly recommend Companion Animal Hospital River North. 10/10 team.
They treat Yoshi like a prince!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

We called about our two cats when they were both experiencing similar digestive problems. They got us an appointment within 24 hours, and we didn't sit in the waiting room to get checked in for more than a couple minutes.

They were understanding when we were running about 10 minutes late because of traffic, too, and we did not have to reschedule our appointment or get pushed back.

Very friendly and knowledgeable staff here. Happy to report we were in and out in about 45 minutes. After thorough checkups for both of our boys and some bloodwork, they sent us home with some mediciation that worked within 2 doses to help our little guys go to the bathroom after a few days of constipation.

Will absolutely come back here for all of our non-emergency veterinary needs.
I have been coming here for a couple of years after my dog was diagnosed with cancer. The level of care and support I received during that difficult time has kept me a loyal customer.
Great staff.  Dr. Bryant is always great with my boys.  I drive all the way from the suburbs to see her and the staff.
My pug love the team and Dr. Bryant!

I’ve been a longtime client of Companion Animal Hospital River North with my dog, Happy.   The veterinarians and other service people in this hospital are very polite, friendly and patient.  They gave my dog professional exams, treatments, and helpful support.   I appreciate their assistance, and thanks so much for their good jobs.

UPDATE: April 25th, 2026
I noticed in another review the keeping of funds was documented. This is also the keeping of funds with a threat from Megan Wisely, Director of Legal Operations for Mission Vets Partners. She knows how to bully yet when confronted with legalities she vanished.
This group may orchestrate the misuse of clients' Insurance programs in order to make their bottom line increase. They also keep the earned rewards funds. This is not ok and a reason I am grateful for not buying passes. They keep the funds even when they are 100% wrong and the care of your precious animal is 100% below the standard.
The door is open for the return of the funds.
*********************************************
UPDATE: April 8th, 2026
In all of my conversations, I brought up the Standard of Care. That care is non-existent at Companion. I expected the retaliative letter to end the relationship and was prepared with scheduled Vet and DayCare interviews. There were options other than their path. Also, the rewards program of which I spent and am owed funds was not tallied. I adhere to transparency and Mission Vets Partners adheres to covert actions and silence and fear of mutual consent legalities.
I believe in immediate care for intestinal problems as diarrhea vs ordering online!
I believe in fact checking and staff who looks up when we enter the room.
I believe in accountability for losing money for the client.
I believe that Snowball knows she did not receive the Standard of Care.
I am happy for her that her vaccine chart was finally organized since Companion just could not accomplish the task!
*********************************************
UPDATE: APRIL 6th, 2026
I will gladly put this review back to the 5 Star Category yet the Owner MUST call and TALK to me. Since early March I have lost funds and lost time and although I repeat and resend documents ... 2 higher ups cannot comprehend the details and another higher up does not want to TALK.
The Owner can get my number from the front desk and if the Owner lost the funds, I am sure no one would suggest to just lose it this time.
I am Snowball's care giver and no one sends or writes any word to a third party without my approval. I have been told "the scribe" machine makes the mistakes!!!
*********************************************
Snowball has gone to Companion Animal Hospital DayCare for her 4 years. We now live in a different State and whenever in Chicago she enjoys playing with all of her friends! They make memorable moments that add up for Snowball :)
We love CAHRN! We use them as a vet and a daycare and 5 stars for both. Our dog is so happy here!

We always had the best experience here, my dog feels so comfortable in our visits she doesn’t want to leave! They are very knowledgeable and friendly, the environment is calm and welcoming, I couldn’t ask for a better care for my Mocha!

Terrible visit. My dog was experiencing some scooting on his behind. Came renege paid for the visit, within a week same issue. Caller the vet, they wanted me to wait for a week, still scooting. Called spoke to Megan, very rude , raised her voice like she was talking to a child. 0/10 would not recommend.
I’m so happy and have a piece of mind Knowing that my G is healthy and happy💓🩷🥰💗  🐈‍⬛
The staff at Companion has always been professional and calming. We feel very cared for there!

Companion Anima Hospital River North has done a great job caring for my dog for the 5 years I’ve had her. The vets, techs, and receptionists are attentive, kind, and knowledgeable. I would highly recommend them for any pet healthcare needs.

I recently transferred my cat's car to Companion Animal Hospital and am SO pleased! My cat is normally skittish at the vet but all the staff quickly put her at ease. Her exam was very thorough and I am so happy to have her well-cared for!
Dr Bryant is Fiona’s absolute favorite. They take such great care of her each and every time!

I’ve had a great experience here at companion animal Hospital, River North. They do a thorough exam and really treated My cat with love and nurture. Fortunately for me, it’s in walking distance to my house, so it was very convenient. The only reason I took one star off is because it is very expensive. However, it is in a downtown city, so that makes sense. I just wish there were some additional promotions to help provide some discounts.

We are taking our dog to Costa Rica with us. Companion knows all about the complex paperwork and exams required, and they take care of everything. Yes, it’s very expensive, but we trust them and we wouldn’t go anywhere else. We’re also planning for her dental work when we get home. Again, very expensive, but I wouldn’t go anywhere else!

Companion Animal Hospital River North has done an excellent job of caring for my three dogs. The vets and staff are welcoming, attentive and willing to go the extra mile. We recently moved but still make the drive to Companion even though we have another vet a block away from us.

We took a dog named Sophie to this place, she was bleeding today and we took her over fast as possible due to obvious fear of what could end up happening to her, and apparently just checking her in for this problem of her bleeding (she was bleeding inside of the hospital too and no one cared or instantly wanted to help us) and just for checking her in, it was a 1000$ bill just to check her in. And even if we let them take her, they wouldn't even provide surgery for the problem right away, they would keep her over night on fluids so she would STILL be bleeding overnight. We are going to have e to take her to another animal vet but this place being called a pet vet and doing shit this absurd, is horrible and disgusting. This place shouldn't even be a pet vet, and is absolutely horrible for having this happen.

Companion Animal Hospital took such incredible care of my dog, Betty, during her spay and umbilical hernia surgery this week. From the moment we walked in, I felt completely at ease, and more importantly, Betty did too. Dr. Bryant and the team were gentle, patient, and so attentive, and they followed up afterward to make sure she was recovering well.

They also went above and beyond to help me sort through an insurance issue, providing all the documentation I needed to submit an appeal. Every interaction was kind, friendly, and genuinely helpful. I’m so grateful for their support and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate vet.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Great experience! Very nice staff and great with my dog!

We've seen Dr. Palacios twice now with my dog, and he's been great. He's super thorough and took the time to answer all of my questions (I always have a ton). He really made me feel comfortable and, most importantly, I could tell my dog was in great hands and being well cared for.

My experience with Companion Animal Hospital River North was incredibly stressful, costly, and unprofessional. I came here months in advance (starting June 24, 2025) to prepare all vaccinations and to make sure my dog would have the international travel certificate needed for a one-way international flight.
On August 23, I brought all required documents and was told again that everything would be done on time. They even claimed the documents were sent electronically to the USDA that same day. This turned out to be misleading because the FedEx label was not created until August 29, only after I went in to check on the status.
On August 29, the doctor assured me the certificate would arrive the next day (August 30). But the next morning, I received an email saying it would not be ready due to USDA delays and the holiday weekend — leaving me with no certificate and a flight scheduled for September 1.
When I returned to the clinic on August 30 to understand what happened, no doctor or manager was present, nobody could answer basic questions, and the information they gave contradicted what they previously told me (first they said USDA takes 5 days, then suddenly it was 10 days).
Because of this clinic’s mistakes and lack of communication, I lost money on:
Flight rescheduling
Multiple taxi rides
Lost income for myself and my daughter
Additional expenses abroad
Plus the $544 certificate fee and hundreds more spent on vaccinations here
My lease ended on August 31, I had already quit my job based on their timeline, and the amount of stress this caused — especially as someone who has been on antidepressants for 10 years — was overwhelming.
This was one of the most unprofessional veterinary experiences I’ve ever had. I would not recommend this hospital to anyone who needs reliable, timely, or honest service.
Awesome vets, nurses, and staff!

Horrible Service Horrible care, DO NOT GO. Made an appointment two weeks out, rescheduled via phone a week before, got to the appointment on the dot only to hear "sorry we cant find your appointment, looks like it wasn't made". We said thats okay people make mistakes and came back an hour later to only hear sorry youre two minutes past our 15 minute policy you have to reschedule again........so two weeks of preparation and planning, and you cant take us after being a few minutes late. Two hours wasted time and my poor kitten is crying. I would never recommend this horrible vet to anyone. Im in disbelief of how bad this customer service is.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

Great vet! I appreciate that they were able to see Butter same day and give her medicine so she could start feeling better. Her paw is already doing much better and the swelling has gone down. Thank you for making her feel so comfortable!

We have been taking our dog Lumi to this vet since we moved to Chicago and we’ve always received great service. Our last visit, we weren’t made aware that the cleaning needed was complimentary, and this time the bill was higher. Instead of fighting us on questioning it, they looked back and realized they didn’t let us know it was complimentary the first time, so they comped it for us this time as well. Truly great people, would recommend for any dog!!

Thank you for your feedback. Unfortunately we cannot find your information in our system to follow up on what your specific feedback is for this rating.  Please email our Practice Manager at amanda.hernandez1@mvetpartners.com so she can further assist you and we can resolve any issues you may have.
Dr. Bryant and the team are great. She removed the cancer from Honey's eye, which has not grown back. I'd recommend. Also, the location is great!
Thank you so much to the staff  for excellent first time service he had way too much fun lol. Bo is so happy to join the Companion River north family ❤️

Unprofessional and unreliable — happened TWICE.
I regret ever trusting this clinic again. The first time, they ran tests on my cat, took a large amount of money, and never followed up with the results. I came back a second time — only because they’re close to my home — and the same thing happened again.
No explanation, no communication, just a receipt and silence. This is not how a vet clinic should operate. They clearly care more about collecting money than providing actual care. I will never return, and I don’t recommend anyone who truly cares about their pet to risk going there
Thank you for your positive rating! We're delighted to know you had a great experience with us.

For the past three years, we have taken our Maltese boy to this clinic, and each time we have received excellent care. The entire staff is helpful, polite, and professional. We feel reassured that our dog is in good hands with every visit. We are also deeply grateful to Dr. Kaya Bryant for her exceptional efforts during a challenging period in the last month. After traveling to a high-risk country for rabies, we urgently needed USDA certification for our dog's US-issued rabies vaccination to meet CDC regulations for bringing him back to the US. We were genuinely surprised and grateful that Dr. Bryant finished everything in an hour. Her speed, skill, and willingness to help were vital. Fantastic team, excellent hospital, highly recommend!

We have used this vet office for about 3 years. Two different vets there prescribed the wrong dose of medication to my small dog on two separate occasions. The first time I caught it and adjusted the dose to her weight. The second time I did not and it caused her to overdose. I will be changing vets going forward.
James was very helpful!
Super friendly, understanding, and patient with both of our cats. Excellent service! We love it here!

Horrible horrible horrible experience.

I went in at 10:30am on Monday and my dog got a bump tested to see if it is cancerous. They told me I would hear back by EOD. I did not hear back by end of day, so I call towards the end of day the following day. The receptionist said the technician forgot but would speak to me after his current appointment. Now it's 5 min before they close and I haven't received a call so I have to reach out again. Now she tells me that the doctor cannot speak to me today because he is "busy prioritizing other clients that are also behind". I said I'm here on the phone so he should prioritize this right now. She then proceeds to tell me that he actually hasn't even looked at the results yet. So now I'm left to spend the rest of my night anxious about the results. Oh, and all of this happened after I had to call THREE separate times to get a copy of my receipt emailed. Oh and they overcharge ridiculously compared to other vets in the area. Wish I listened to the other reviews and went elsewhere.
We got wonderful care!  We were driving in from out of town and the got us in right away and treated Farrah's eye infection.  What a wonderful team!!!💕🐶 …
The most amazing Animal Hospital EVER!! The team is the VIBE! My pup is not a easy to get along with, and the team took such good care of her. WE WILL BE BACK!! thank you again for being amazing!!!!
We have been coming to companion animal river north for about 5-6 years and have had amazing care with all of the doctors and techs here. Our cats love Dr. Bryant!
Professional and caring

I’ve been taking my Pomeranian to Companion since she was born and we have been so thankful for their team. From her checkups, to medical scares, we have always been in great hands. Special shoutout to James and Jasmine as we went in for monthly meds and they took extra special care to advise on the best meds for her.
